additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480227-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / R1 170001367] The station does not connect to OCPP CRM:03289000626
additional_info.body:
Dear Poland Service Team,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket ID0480227, opened for issues to connect to OCPP Backend.
I checked a bit on AWS, and it seems to me that the charger never managed to connect to the OCPP Backend, is it correct?
From my investigation, it looks to me that it is not possible to connect to the Backend due to issues either on the SIM card or on internet configuration.
I connected remotely to router XF4 via SSH, and the router has no internet because the SIM card cannot connect to any operator:
At the moment, on the router configuration there is no apn set, nor any authentication mode. But in the mobile settings of the router, the apn "Orange" is set. I tried to set an automatic apn, but got the following result:
I believe it is important to retrieve some information in regards of the SIM card and configure the internet connection correctly. In particular:
Is it a multi operator SIM card or a specific operator?
Does the SIM card require a PIN?
Is the SIM card expired, or the data plan exhausted?
Which is the apn?
Which is the Auth Mode?
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
